meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline: 将AI Runway快速部署到Azure Kubernetes集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在Azure上搭建AI推理环境
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 6 步引导你在已有的 AKS 集群上装 AI Runway：验证集群、装控制器、评估 GPU、装推理 provider、部署首个模型、做总结。每步汇报状态，安装或部署前先征求你确认。
howto.when: 当你提到「setup AI Runway」「deploy model to AKS」等关键词，或要在 AKS 上跑模型推理时触发。前提是已有 AKS 集群，没有则先转给 azure-kubernetes 技能。

say.note: 它会从验证集群开始逐步执行

say.text: 跳过前两步，从第 3 步 GPU 评估开始
say.note: 用 skip-to-step 参数从中途续跑

howto.what_en: On an existing AKS cluster, Claude walks six steps: verify the cluster, install the AI Runway controller, assess GPUs, set up an inference provider, deploy a first model, summarize. It reports status and asks before installing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "setup AI Runway" or "deploy model to AKS", or want model inference on AKS. An AKS cluster must already exist; otherwise it hands off to azure-kubernetes.
